title: Home Claim Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=claim:home
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by claim_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when home insurance claim data has stopped arriving for a given claim type.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per claim type and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your home insurance claim feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
